parsed.name: 数字示波器
parsed.description: Tektronix TDS1002B 台式数字示波器，用于实验室中观察、显示和基本测量电信号波形，如电压随时间变化、频率与时序特性。
parsed.description_en: The Tektronix TDS1002B is a bench digital oscilloscope used in laboratories to observe, display, and perform basic measurements on electrical waveforms, including voltage-versus-time behavior, frequency, and timing characteristics.
